recommendations.title: Fix compound risk: Compound authentication upgrade risk: vulnerable PyJWT 1.7.1 in authentication code with insufficient tests
recommendations.problem: Compound authentication upgrade risk: vulnerable PyJWT 1.7.1 in authentication code with insufficient tests. PyJWT 1.7.1 is affected by 11 known vulnerabilities | Vulnerable pyjwt is used by the authentication component (shopfront/auth/middleware.py) | Upgrading pyjwt 1.7.1 -> 2.14.0 breaks 2 call site(s) in shopfront/auth/middleware.py | Security-critical authentication code has no tests (shopfront/auth/middleware.py, shopfront/auth/passwords.py)
recommendations.why_it_matters: Independent agents verified 4 linked problems across 4 dimensions; together they are worse than each alone (multiplier 1.75).
recommendations.proposed_fix:
1. Upgrade PyJWT from 1.7.1 to 2.14.0 or later (resolves 11 advisories).
2. In the same change, update the breaking call sites (shopfront/auth/middleware.py:17, shopfront/auth/middleware.py:26): Drop the .decode('utf-8') call on the token. Pass an explicit allow-list, e.g. algorithms=["HS256"].
3. Add regression tests for shopfront/auth/middleware.py, shopfront/auth/passwords.py before merging (valid/expired/tampered tokens, wrong algorithm).
4. Re-run Skopeo to confirm the compound risk is closed.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Closes a P0 risk (score 94.5) and makes the upgrade path safe.
